scenicChapters.title: Rio-Santos Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 20 km this is Rio-Santos Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-sitio-roberto-burle-marx-mouth-of.story: It goes by way of Pedra Bonita and Pedra da Gávea - Tijuca N, Mouth of Guanabara Bay and Manmade Shoreli and back through Pedra Bonita and Pedra da Gávea - Tijuca N. The coast is the point of it.
